newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-MOONAX EYES SECOND FRENCH ST LEGER VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-MOONAX EYES SECOND FRENCH ST LEGER VICTORY.

text.p: Moonax chases a second triumph in the French St Leger, the group one Prix Royal-Oak, at Longchamp on Sunday.
The British stayer is noted for his idiosyncracies and, at the same course last season, he attempted to bite his short-head conqueror Always Earnest in the group one Prix du Cadran.
Moonax was up to his old tricks in the same race earlier this month when he veered left, probably taking exception to Frankie Dettori's whip, and losing many lengths.
Once straightened out, Moonax finished with gusto and it was only by a length that he failed to peg back the mud-loving Nononito, whom he faces again here.
Andre Fabre, successful last year with Sunshack, weighs in with the group two Prix de Pomone winner, Helen of Spain, fourth last time in the group two Grand Prix de Deauville to Strategic Choice.
The shorter trip in the Grand Prix may not have been to Helen of Spain's advantage, and a return to the one mile 7-1/2 furlongs distance should prove more congenial.
The very useful Red Roses Story, who has not raced for several months, faces a tough task against some battle-hardened stayers on her reappearance.
